Source contracts: install-no-build.sh

install-no-build.sh

Shell · Tier B

Delegate installation with build-package installation disabled by default.

Usage

Use the maintained installer on hosts that should omit optional system build packages.

Inputs

AOR_INSTALL_NO_BUILD defaults to 1; all CLI arguments pass to install.sh.

Side effects

Inherits package, environment and local Gateway update effects from install.sh.

Cleanup

exec delegates exit status and process lifetime to install.sh.

@see install.sh
